_meta.purpose: Port contract for the ADR-0516 Agentic Delivery Fabric two-plane drive-loop state: a durable, in-repo, PR-governed coordination plane and a repo-adjacent, gitignored operational execution plane, both reachable ONLY through port traits that model the owned cloud-ci-native destination service. This spec is the single named record of the owned cloud-ci cutover target for loop state.

read_contract.freshness_rule: Live port contract, single-writer at this path; conflicts between adapters and this contract resolve to this spec plus the port-level tests in tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/tests/contract.rs. It is never a mandatory entry surface: entry surfaces are exactly /specs/root-hub-pointers.json#agent_entry_surface_allowlist.

coordination.role: Durable plane: loop-card definitions (Definition/Seed card class), dependency references into the masterplan v2 single work-item ID space, durable statuses, and attached evidence references.
coordination.mutation_path: Coordinator-only commits on an isolated worktree branch through a protected PR against dev (coordinator-only commit doctrine of the ADR-0516 fabric loop); workers never write this plane directly.
coordination.status_evidence_rule: A card may reach claimed-done-unverified only with at least one evidence reference attached, and done-verified only through an explicit verification step that attaches verification evidence; unverified done states never surface as done (masterplan v2 evidence_state_policy).

execution.role: Operational plane: claim, heartbeat, block-kind, and run state for in-flight loop cards. High-churn, never merge or plan authority.
execution.gitignore_rule: /.oya-loop-state/ is gitignored at the repo root; operational claim/heartbeat/run state must never enter the PR-governed tree.
execution.mutation_path: Lane runtimes mutate only through ExecutionPlanePort; claims are lane-exclusive and heartbeat/run writes require the claiming lane.

ports.rule: ALL loop-state reads and writes go through the port traits below. The single-writer facades LoopStateService<C: CoordinationPlanePort, E: ExecutionPlanePort> and FlowMetricsService<M: FlowMetricsPort> are generic over the traits and perform no I/O of their own, so no caller can reach a concrete store without crossing a port. The bundled filesystem adapters are retirement-marked local bridges (founder CLI directive 2026-06-09); they carry no merge or plan authority.

flow_metrics.purpose: Closed-loop improvement layer of the ADR-0516 drive loop: per-pass flow metrics — cycle time (claim -> completion), review latency (review request -> first verdict), and rework count (review rounds beyond the first) per measured card — recorded on EVERY dispatch pass, including idle passes (constant-work: the recording load is the same idle or peak).
flow_metrics.record_shape: PassFlowMetrics { pass_seq, recorded_at_epoch_s, cards: [CardFlowMetrics { card_id, lane_id, cycle_time_s, review_latency_s, rework_count }] }
flow_metrics.ledger_rule: Append-only with a strictly monotonic 1-based pass_seq, enforced mechanically at every adapter (validate_pass_record); replays and out-of-order writes fail closed with NonMonotonicPass. Per-card metrics derive mechanically from raw CardFlowTimeline records; inverted timelines fail closed with InvalidMetrics.
flow_metrics.mutation_path: Coordinator-only: the ledger rides the durable coordination plane (PR-governed) and is written once per dispatch pass through FlowMetricsPort via the single-writer FlowMetricsService facade.

lane_disjointness.purpose: Mechanical parallel-safety detector of the ADR-0516 drive loop: a path/ownership-overlap check — NOT judgment — decides what runs concurrently. Each lane declares its work surface (repo-relative file/dir paths for one card); the detector verdicts PRE-FLIGHT over the declared surfaces before dispatch and POST-RUN over the actual touched paths after the lanes ran, and both verdicts are captured as evidence for every parallel dispatch.
lane_disjointness.detector: check_lane_disjointness(phase, surfaces, reviewer_capacity, checked_at_epoch_s) in tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app (bin command: check-disjoint)
lane_disjointness.report_shape: DisjointnessReport { phase: pre-flight|post-run, verdict: disjoint|overlap-serialize-to-integrator, lane_count, reviewer_capacity, checked_at_epoch_s, surfaces: [LaneWorkSurface { lane_id, card_id, paths }], collisions: [PathCollision { lane_a, path_a, lane_b, path_b }] }
lane_disjointness.collision_rule: Two paths in different lanes collide iff they are equal or one is a component-wise directory prefix of the other (a directory path claims its whole subtree; sibling files never collide). Any collision verdicts overlap-serialize-to-integrator: shared-root touches auto-route to the serialized integrator lane instead of parallel dispatch.
lane_disjointness.capacity_rule: Max concurrent lanes <= available independent reviewer capacity (computed from the lane registry by the caller); a batch above capacity fails closed with LaneCapacityExceeded before any disjointness reasoning.
lane_disjointness.fail_closed_inputs: Lane/card ids pass the filesystem-safe id contract; duplicate lane ids and one card on two lanes are refused; paths must be repo-relative with no traversal/absolute/backslash/trailing-slash shapes; empty surfaces or batches are refused (a surface the detector cannot reason about is never admitted as disjoint).
lane_disjointness.gate_semantics: The check-disjoint bin command prints the JSON report (evidence shape) and exits non-zero unless every lane pair is path-disjoint.

cutover_target.statement: The named owned cloud-ci cutover target for BOTH planes is the cloud/cloud-ci-owned loop-state service oya-cloud-ci-loop-state-service (composition-root crate home cloud/cloud-ci/crates/oya-cloud-ci-loop-state-app, ADR-0056 BNF layer suffix). The port traits in tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app model this destination; the bundled filesystem stores are transient bridges behind those ports, never the destination.
cutover_criteria: The service passes the same six-gate plan suite (ID uniqueness, DAG acyclicity, orphan detection, projection freshness, plan-vs-evidence drift, read-contract/entry-surface) with fail-closed authz.
A shadow-parity period drives real cards through the service with zero regressions versus the local bridge stores.
The local bridge stores are demoted to read-only bridge and then retired.
cutover_target.local_store_disposition: bridge-then-retire: after criteria 1-2 hold, FsCoordinationStore/FsExecutionStore flip to read-only bridge, then retire; the port traits and LoopStateService survive unchanged over the service adapter.

non_authority_statement: Neither plane store nor the bundled bin is a CI, merge, or plan authority surface. Plan authority stays at /specs/masterplan.json; merge authority stays the single protected oya-ci-required context (ADR-0515).
